bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over cases (resampling with replacement), shared resamples across systems
bootstrap.scope: statistical intervals over this synthetic benchmark sample, not field-performance confidence intervals

conventions.zero_division: precision/recall are undefined (null) when their denominator is 0; F1 = 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) is undefined only when that denominator is 0; macro-F1 averages the defined per-type F1 values; rates with a zero denominator are null.

scope_statements.ablations: The physical-only and digital-only systems are internal ablations, not external commercial baselines.
scope_statements.intervals: Confidence intervals are bootstrap statistical intervals over this synthetic benchmark sample; they are not field-performance confidence intervals.
scope_statements.latency: Latency is engine evaluation latency only: it measures the time to evaluate evidence that already exists as events and excludes camera capture, YOLO detection, tracking and UI rendering. It is not end-to-end latency and it is specific to the machine that measured it.
scope_statements.split_status: This report covers the DEVELOPMENT split only. The FINAL split has been generated but no system has been evaluated on it.
scope_statements.synthetic: This benchmark uses procedurally generated synthetic event sequences. It evaluates deterministic procedure-integrity reasoning, not live-camera accuracy or field performance.

simple_baseline_rules: A step appears if a physical STEP_OBSERVED (confidence >= 0.50) or a digital STEP_COMPLETED names it; STEP_FAILED never counts.
OMISSION:X is raised for every required step X that appears in neither channel.
ORDER_INVERSION:X is raised for every step X that occurs after a higher-order step within one channel's collapsed time-ordered sequence; channels are never merged.
Status is VIOLATED if any label was raised, otherwise COMPLETED; there is no UNCERTAIN.
No cross-channel contradiction and no unsupported-digital-completion (phantom) reasoning.

digital_only_ablation.description: The same ConformanceEngine with the physical channel removed: it receives digital evidence only (an internal ablation, not an external product).

full_dual_channel.description: The unmodified M0 ConformanceEngine given both physical and digital evidence.

physical_only_ablation.description: The same ConformanceEngine with the digital channel removed: it receives physical evidence only (an internal ablation, not an external product).

simple_procedure_check.description: Transparent required-steps-present + monotonic-order checker; no cross-channel reasoning.
